name: wondermap
description: WonderMap - a web-based fantasy map painter for D&D worlds (Vite + React + Bootstrap + Node.js)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
